name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: GRU-linked plot in Estonia; sabotage up 16%
summary: IISS says on 27 Nov Russian sabotage attacks in Europe rose 16%; Estonia closes its Russian border from 1 Dec
state: An IISS report published on 27 Nov found Russian sabotage attacks in Europe up 16%, with Ukraine supply lines targeted (NBC News). Estonia said it will shut its border with Russia after a GRU-linked attempt to sabotage a drone maker on 14 Nov (Euronews, 20 Nov). A state-attributed sabotage plot keeps Watch; searches to 28 Nov found no sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
for_you: Sabotage and drone incidents can disrupt airports, rail and energy sites at short notice. Follow guidance from national police and security services.
rubric_hit: Sabotage incident attributed to a state = Watch; no casualties or major outage

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
